prereg.milestone: G7a — carrier-superposition falsification (frozen model, zero training)
prereg.hypothesis_under_test: zdelta writes K' = K_native + f(z) onto a placeholder ('.') token, so the carrier key is a SUPERPOSITION of dot-identity and content. Text has a clean key. Later composition steps must re-attend to this value and see a contaminated key -- hence the composition-after-delivery penalty (research.md 4.45).
prereg.status_of_hypothesis: This is the FIFTH mechanism narrative from the implementing agent; the previous four were all refuted. It is therefore tested by a pre-locked falsifier BEFORE any repair is attempted.

pre_locked_prediction.direction: Episodes whose carrier key stays CLOSER to the native dot key (higher cos) are MORE contaminated, hence should have MORE NEGATIVE dm. Predicted correlation between cos(K', K_dot) and dm is NEGATIVE.
pre_locked_prediction.primary_statistic: Spearman rho between per-episode cos(K', K_dot) and per-episode dm, at j=3, config=mixed
pre_locked_prediction.inconclusive: -0.30 < rho < -0.15 (report as inconclusive; do NOT proceed to a fix)

secondary_predictors: signal-to-carrier norm ratio ||f(z)|| / ||K_native||  (higher = less contaminated = dm less negative, so predicted POSITIVE rho)
same two statistics on the VALUE side (V' vs V_dot)
prereg.controls_required_before_any_placeholder: If the correlation is negative, a placeholder variant must match content, position, norm and token statistics -- otherwise the swap changes more than key contamination (Codex). A positive result is only a NECESSARY condition, never sufficient causality.
prereg.dm_measurement: teacher-forced, same teacher, same positions, identical to research.md 4.47 (m_text from the all-explicit arm; dm = m_delivery - m_text). Cells where the text teacher is below 95% are censored.
prereg.no_training: Frozen core, frozen zdelta-v1. Nothing is trained in this experiment.
